ios.desc:
Castream turns your phone into a live studio, and now into a shorts editor too.

Go live to YouTube, Facebook, Twitch and any RTMP platform at the same time, then let AI Shorts turn the best moments into captioned vertical clips, ready to post on TikTok, Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts.

NEW: AI SHORTS
• Finds your best moments: Castream listens to your video, reads your chat and picks the moments worth sharing
• Vertical clips with captions: up to 60 seconds each, word-by-word captions and a hook to open
• Any video: your streams, a video from your phone, or a Google Drive, Dropbox or direct video link
• Caption styles and editor: pick a look, drag the captions where you want them, fix any word and update the short for free
• Share anywhere: save to your phone or share straight to your apps, with the title and hashtags copied for you
• Included with Creator (50 credits a month) and Pro (200 credits a month). 1 credit = 1 minute of video

GO LIVE EVERYWHERE
• Multistreaming: YouTube, Facebook, Twitch, TikTok Live and Instagram Live (with an RTMP key), and custom RTMP destinations, all at once
• Camera, screen, or both: stream your camera, broadcast your phone's screen for gaming, tutorials and demos, or use front and back cameras together with picture-in-picture
• Keep streaming when you switch apps
• Scheduled broadcasts: upload a video, pick a time, and it goes live on its own

YOUR LIVE STUDIO
• Overlays and lower thirds, edited in real time
• Live location overlay
• Camera filters and voice effects
• Portrait and landscape

CHAT AND CO-PILOT
• One chat for YouTube, Facebook and Twitch
• Moderator mode: run chat from a second device with a QR code
• Copilot: control a stream running on another device

AFTER THE STREAM
• Recordings kept for 30 days (Creator and Pro)
• Chat Insights: AI summaries of what your audience loved (paid plans)
• AI titles and descriptions for your streams
• Public profile at castream.io/@yourname

BUILT FOR QUALITY
• Up to 1080p (Pro) or 720p
• Auto bitrate that adapts to your network
• Low latency, with audio and video in sync
• No watermark on paid plans

Free to start. Upgrade when you need more.

Go live everywhere, then post the best part.

By using this app, you agree to Apple’s standard [Terms of Use (EULA)](https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/).

show_hn.title: Show HN: Castream – Native iOS/Android IRL multistreaming app

quotes.text:
Hey HN,

I just launched the iOS version of Castream, a native app that lets you multistream directly from your phone to platforms like Twitch, YouTube, Facebook, and any custom RTMP endpoint. Android has been live for a bit — iOS just went up this week.

This was built to solve the usual pain points of mobile streaming: unreliable apps, no multistream support, or being forced to go through a PC. Castream uses native encoding and streams straight from your phone using real RTMP — no browser wrappers or WebRTC hacks.

Some quick details:
 • Native iOS and Android apps (hardware-accelerated video/audio encoding)
 • Multistreaming with your own RTMP keys
 • Free plan supports 720p to two destinations, up to 5 minutes per stream
 • Paid plans unlock 1080p, more destinations, unlimited stream time, and other features
 • Backend is FastAPI, using FFmpeg on-device for muxing/streaming
 • Built this solo — full stack + native mobile (Swift/Java/Kotlin)

We’re currently getting early sign-ups mostly through organic reach — haven’t spent anything on ads yet, just trying to get real users and feedback.

Links:
iOS: https://apps.apple.com/app/castream/id6747093725
Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=io.castream.app
Website: https://www.castream.io

Would love any feedback — especially from folks building in video, streaming infra, or native mobile.

Thanks.
